exceptions.reason: TRUE OF THE CARD-MODE VARIANT ONLY. The wide layout is a real <table> with role="grid", one roving tab stop and a cursor that starts on the first column header. Below --bp-md the table renders one card per row -- a list, not a grid -- and a card with `onRowClick` set has no keyboard route at all: it is a <div> with onClick and cursor:pointer. The obvious fix is invalid ARIA, which is why it is recorded rather than done: tabIndex={0} plus role="button" cannot go on a card that also contains the consumer's own buttons, because the actions column (mobileLayout: 'block') draws them INSIDE it. The other requirements of this pattern are vacuous rather than unmet in card mode -- the grid pattern's subject is the grid element, and there is no grid element there -- but this one costs a keyboard user a capability they have in the wide layout, so it is an exception and not a silence. Separately, and in BOTH layouts: a cell whose content the consumer draws -- an actions column's Button, which both in-tree call sites draw -- is a page-level tab stop Arena cannot silence, the same wall CalendarEvent's open panel hit and which its prompt documents as "the exception and is meant to be"; frameworks/react/test/table.test.jsx pins that as a second tab stop so the claim is verifiable rather than asserted. The binding cannot scope a requirement to a variant -- the same limit `Skeleton` proves, recorded in CLAUDE.md's Known debt -- so this whole exception reads as unconditional and is not.
